semantics: Documentation graphs, not executable n8n workflows. Edges are process/data-flow compositions supported by references; planned edges are proposals.
title: Product & catalog management
subtitle: Owner-controlled product publishing, taxonomy and index updates

nodes.label: Edit product or category
nodes.description: Owner catalog editor; create, update or remove catalog records.

nodes.label: Admin product / category API
nodes.description: Category CRUD has its own routes; inspect the API inventory for each method.

nodes.label: Authorize store owner
nodes.description: JWT session plus normalized OWNER or ADMIN role.

nodes.label: Create / update catalog
nodes.description: Server normalizes product data, variants and media. Category records are maintained separately.

nodes.label: Products and categories
nodes.description: Persist actual catalog collections; category matching includes name, slug and department logic rather than a declared foreign key.

nodes.label: Sync Algolia index
nodes.description: Writes run only when a write key exists. Index errors are logged and are non-blocking. Runtime configuration and connectivity are Unverified.

nodes.label: Publication & stock filter
nodes.description: Storefront excludes unpublished, draft, archived and imported/demo records and overlays inventory balances.

nodes.label: Updated storefront catalog
nodes.description: Catalog listings display published products and supported facets.

nodes.label: Request failed
nodes.description: Validation, access, conflict or service errors are returned to the caller. Status and error shape depend on the specific route.

nodes.label: Show error / retry
nodes.description: Failure end state. Caller receives the actual error; a retry may be offered by the UI.

notes: Source implementation is documented; deployed configuration and provider connectivity are not verified.
Algolia synchronization is optional and best effort; successful database writes do not prove the search index was updated.
